method: Evidence-led behavioural avatars. Names and demographic bands are modelling devices, not measured customer segments. Spend corridors are anchored to current menus; frequency and conversion assumptions are explicitly inferred and must be tested.

avatars.name: Alex, the time-boxed CBD luncher

demographic_frame.description: Office-based or city-visiting adult, modelled broadly at 25-44

avatars.job_to_be_done: Give me a meal that feels fresh and distinctive, arrives predictably, and fits inside a short work break.
barriers: premium sandwich above perceived lunch value

price_behaviour.price_anchor_notes: Diego & Co. schiacciate are $17-$25; Fabbrica takeaway sando is $18; FISHBOWL core bowls are $13.90-$21.90; Bar Allora express lunch is $25.

model_assumptions.test: Track identified cohort reorder rate at 30 and 60 days.

model_assumptions.value: core lunch order handed over within 8 minutes
model Thursday as strongest CBD weekday
model_assumptions.test: Compare four weeks of day-of-week transactions.

evidence.claim: City-centre public-transport visitation averaged 3.2m per week in June 2026, with Thursday busiest.
evidence.title: City economic monitor, July 2026

evidence.claim: CBD menu anchors span $17-$25 for schiacciate, $18 takeaway sandwich and $25 express lunch.
evidence.title: Diego & Co. official menu and venue page

evidence.claim: A dense salad/bowl alternative spans $13.90-$21.90 and has multiple CBD sites.
evidence.title: FISHBOWL menu

avatars.name: Maya, the Inner West habitual local

demographic_frame.description: Local renter or owner, creative/professional/student mix, modelled broadly at 23-39

avatars.job_to_be_done: Be my reliable local: easy enough for Tuesday, good-looking enough for Saturday, and varied enough to revisit.
barriers: feels like a copy of another retro Italian venue

price_behaviour.price_anchor_notes: IL BARETTO pasta $20-$33 and $29-$49 solo bundles; The Italian Bowl pasta $22-$30 and spritz $16.

model_assumptions.value: 2-4 visits per month across lunch and dinner
model_assumptions.test: Measure 30/60-day cohort repeat and category switching.

model_assumptions.value: two rotating items per category should drive revisit without expanding SKU count
model_assumptions.test: Track rotation attach and repeat by customer ID.

model_assumptions.value: model 35%-55% of food orders as takeaway in alpha
model_assumptions.test: Observe first eight weeks by daypart.

evidence.claim: King Street high-street spend rose year on year in the June 2026 City monitor, although magnitude was not published on the page.
evidence.title: City economic monitor, July 2026

evidence.claim: Newtown has two current direct pasta competitors with noon-to-late trade and core pasta at $20-$30.
evidence.title: IL BARETTO Newtown, Pasta, Focaccia & Tiramisu

evidence.claim: The Italian Bowl publishes $22-$30 pasta, $16-$26 salads and service to 10pm or 11pm.
evidence.title: Menu, The Italian Bowl

avatars.name: Rosa and Marco, the heritage household connectors
avatars.segment_role: family occasion, local advocacy and take-home

demographic_frame.description: Multi-generational local household or family group; no fixed age is assumed

occasions: introducing friends to a local place
avatars.job_to_be_done: Respect the food and the story, feed different ages without fuss, and make it worth choosing over a familiar deli or home meal.

price_behaviour.price_anchor_notes: Reported Raineri sandwich $15 is secondary evidence; IL BARETTO two-person bundle is $79 and The Italian Bowl pasta is $22-$30.

model_assumptions.test: Track basket size, group size and repeat separately from solo lunch.

model_assumptions.value: 2-4 food items plus optional drinks or take-home
model_assumptions.test: Measure units per transaction and dine-in/takeaway split on weekends.

model_assumptions.value: real family detail should outperform generic Italian nostalgia
model_assumptions.test: Qualitative intercepts and message recall; do not invent unverified family history.

evidence.claim: Raineri's has a longstanding Five Dock location and 2026 secondary coverage reports strong queues around a $15 focaccia sandwich.
evidence.title: Why hundreds of Aussies are lining up outside this tiny Sydney deli

evidence.claim: Sydney's Little Italy program demonstrates active contemporary Italian cultural programming in Leichhardt.
evidence.title: Little Italy Sydney program 2026

evidence.claim: Current family/two-person takeaway reference is $79 at IL BARETTO Newtown.
evidence.title: IL BARETTO Newtown, Pasta, Focaccia & Tiramisu

avatars.name: Priya, the after-work aperitivo socialiser
avatars.segment_role: margin, evening conversion and brand advocacy

demographic_frame.description: Professional or social city user, modelled broadly at 27-45

avatars.job_to_be_done: Make the transition out of work feel immediate: a good drink, a small plate, music and atmosphere without committing to a full formal dinner.
choice_drivers: easy extension into pasta or shared plates
barriers: venue still feels like a daytime takeaway
no licence or slow drinks service

price_behaviour.price_anchor_notes: Bloom aperitivo drinks $7-$14 and snacks $6-$18; Bar Allora promo drinks $10-$15; standard IL BARETTO spritz $18.

model_assumptions.value: 10%-20% of eligible late-afternoon passers or existing café customers during alpha tests
model_assumptions.test: Count eligible footfall, offer views, orders and extensions into dinner separately.
Track beverage-only, beverage-plus-food and dinner-extension rates.

model_assumptions.value: evening revenue must be forecast from evening observations, not lunch sales
model_assumptions.test: Maintain separate daypart P&Ls and conversion funnels.

evidence.claim: Bloom publishes an explicit café-to-aperitivo transition at 3pm and drinks $7-$14 with small plates $6-$18 during 3-6pm.
evidence.title: Aperitivo Menu, Bloom Potts Point

evidence.claim: Bar Allora offers two aperitivo windows with $15 spritz/negroni and $10 house beer/wine.
evidence.title: Bar Allora Sydney

evidence.claim: Potts Point high-street consumer spend rose year on year in the June 2026 City monitor, without magnitude on the landing page.
evidence.title: City economic monitor, July 2026
